summary.zh: 吉祥物乘交通工具一镜到底横穿一座扁平插画城市，每个街区是一个内容类别：顶部一张车票标着路线和站名，每站甩来一张明信片写这一类的代表内容，天色从白天走到夜晚，终点把每站盖进一张集章卡。适合内容多、类别清楚的产品（内容平台、多功能软件、多门店多品类、课程体系）
summary.en: A mascot rides through a flat-illustrated city in one continuous take; each district is a content category: a ticket at the top tracks the route and the stop name, a postcard for each stop carries a sample title, the sky moves from day to night, and the ride ends with every stop stamped onto a stamp card. Fits products with many clearly separated categories
